title: On Assuming that the matter was settled
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：assume　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 assume 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the tailor ① assumed that the matter was settled with great care, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② assumes that the matter was settled on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ assume that the matter was settled at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ assumed that the matter was settled before — a line in the order for November 1950 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Assuming that the matter was settled with great care, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ assume the whole cost himself on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Assume the whole cost himself at once and never mention it again.

By 1963 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ assumes the whole cost himself with great care every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ assumed that the matter was settled again when nobody else would.

⑩ To assume that the matter was settled, my mother said in 1968, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody assumes that the matter was settled on the same day again and somebody must assume that the matter was settled with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 假定（一般过去式 assumed that the matter was settled：1956 年裁缝头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 假定（一般现在 assumes that the matter was settled：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 假定（不定式 to assume that the matter was settled：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 假定（过去完成时 had assumed that the matter was settled：1950 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 假定（动名词 assuming that the matter was settled 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 承担（assume the whole cost himself：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去承担独自担下整笔花销）
G. v. 承担（assume the whole cost himself：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 假定（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 assumes the whole cost himself，而母亲又一次 assumed that the matter was settled）

answers.why: assume 意为“假定”，1956 年裁缝小心翼翼地假定那件事已经定了，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 assumed。
assume 意为“假定”，自那以后裁缝当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 assumes。
assume 意为“假定”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯假定那件事已经定了”，此处为不定式 to assume that the matter was settled。
assume 意为“假定”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1963 年之前就有人假定过，故用过去完成时 had assumed。
assume 意为“假定”，裁缝说“假定那件事已经定了这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 assuming that the matter was settled 作主语。
assume 意为“承担”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去承担独自担下整笔花销”，should ever 之后用原形 assume the whole cost himself。
assume 意为“承担”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻承担独自担下整笔花销（assume the whole cost himself at once），以后再也不要提起。
assume 意为“假定”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例承担独自担下整笔花销，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 assumes。
assume 意为“假定”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地假定那件事已经定了，用一般过去式 assumed 叙述。
assume 意为“假定”，结尾那句是母亲 1968 年的话：要假定那件事已经定了，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 assume 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the tailor assumed that the matter was settled with great care, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor assumes that the matter was settled on the same day whenever the shop asks.
Assuming that the matter was settled with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever assume the whole cost himself on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop assumes the whole cost himself with great care every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother assumed that the matter was settled again, and the shop remembered that half.
